Lecture 1 · Value functions & Bellman equations

State and action values, a step-by-step derivation of the Bellman expectation equation, the matrix form and its closed-form solution, and the Bellman optimality equations.

Lecture 2 · Dynamic programming

Contractions, synchronous and in-place policy evaluation, the policy improvement theorem, policy iteration, value iteration, GPI and a full walkthrough on the delivery-drone MDP.
